description: This file defines the LLM_Agentflow class implementing an LLM node for agent workflows, including methods for handling memory, streaming responses, and integrating with external systems.

classes.name: LLM_Agentflow
classes.description: Implements an LLM node for agent workflows, managing conversation memory, streaming responses, and response processing.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Provides methods to list models and runtime state keys.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method for the LLM node, handling message preparation, memory, invocation, and response streaming.

methods.name: handleMemory
methods.description: Manages conversation memory based on the selected memory type.

methods.name: handleSummaryBuffer
methods.description: Handles summarization of conversation history when token limits are exceeded.

methods.name: handleStreamingResponse
methods.description: Streams response chunks from the LLM and streams tokens via SSE.

methods.name: prepareOutputObject
methods.description: Prepares the final output object with response content and metadata.

methods.name: sendStreamingEvents
methods.description: Streams additional events such as tool calls and metadata via SSE.
